The attribution a style asks maps to show

Source: R/layer_utils.R
get_attribution.Rd

Every source the styles' layers draw from contributes its attribution (from the style, the source's TileJSON or PMTiles metadata), as MapLibre's attribution control collects it: plain text, without duplicates, joined with " | ". Use it for a caption or credit line, e.g. labs(caption = get_attribution(style)). Python: basemapper.get_attribution() and m.get_attribution().

Usage

get_attribution(x, auth_token = NULL)

Arguments

x

A view from basemap(), or a style (anything basemap() takes) or vector of styles stacked bottom to top.

auth_token

Optional access token for the tile service (for a view, its own is used).

Value

A character string; "" when the styles give no attribution.

Examples

get_attribution("Esri.WorldImagery")
#> [1] "Tiles © Esri — Source: Esri, i-cubed, USDA, USGS, AEX, GeoEye, Getmapping, Aerogrid, IGN, IGP, UPR-EGP, and the GIS User Community"
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
m <- basemap("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", center = c(-111.89, 40.76), zoom = 12)
get_attribution(m)
} # }
